projects.name: PENTEX
projects.summary: A local RAG knowledge base over my own pentest notes. Ask in natural language, get answers grounded in my Obsidian vault, running fully on-premises.
points: FastAPI backend with a natural-language query API
Local models via Ollama: nomic-embed-text for embeddings, qwen2.5 for answers
Vault watcher re-indexes notes on change
Web UI to ask and read sourced answers

projects.name: WAF bypass corpus
projects.summary: A structured corpus of WAF bypass payloads that stays reusable across engagements. One source of truth, all wordlists generated from it.
points: Single JSONL source of truth, wordlists are generated, never hand-edited
Each entry carries dated empirical results per WAF (bypass, blocked, partial)
Generated wordlists load straight into ffuf, Burp Intruder, wfuzz, nuclei
Payloads tagged by class and technique for targeted fuzzing

ISO 27001 for the scope: risk analysis (EBIOS RM, Egerie), policies, certification audit
